channel.title: The Colorado Sun - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Colorado Sun (coloradosun.com)

item.title: Opinion: Denverites want Flock license plate cameras out of town. Air surveillance should be next to go.
item.description: Denver police are flying hundreds of drone missions over the city, but with little outrage as seen with Flock

item.title: An old land dispute in the San Luis Valley pits the privacy of a billionaire’s new home against grazing sheep
item.description: A multiday hearing with roots in the Sangre de Cristo Land Grant of 1844 takes place this week in Costilla County

item.title: With no Colorado River deal in sight, risk of federal action intensifies. Here’s what that means.
item.description: Coloradans are worried the Trump administration can simply give Colorado River water to favored states. Is that possible?

item.title: New Mexico is making child care free for all working parents. Why isn’t Colorado?
item.description: Even before the universal policy, New Mexico had much more generous child care assistance than Colorado

item.title: Democrats aim to roll back business tax breaks to fund new per-child benefit for lower-income Colorado families
item.description: Many of the business tax breaks targeted under the plan were created or expanded by Republicans in Congress through their One Big Beautiful Bill Act

item.title: Jared Polis taps Judge Susan Blanco to serve on Colorado Supreme Court
item.description: Blanco beat out two other finalists — District Judge Christopher Zenisek and Solicitor General Andrea Wang — for the vacancy left by the resignation of Justice Melissa Hart in December

item.title: 4 killed, 29 injured in 36-vehicle pileup on Interstate 25 near Pueblo
item.description: The Colorado State Patrol urged drivers to avoid driving until conditions improved, citing low visibility. The cause of the crash is under investigation.

item.title: Palantir departs Denver, moves headquarters to Miami
item.description: Valued at $300B, Palantir was the largest publicly traded company in Colorado. CEO Alex Karp recently bought a monastery in Old Snowmass.

item.title: Wind-driven wildfires prompt evacuations on Colorado’s Eastern Plains
item.description: Firefighters worked to control the flames as strong winds pushed across dry land in eastern Colorado

item.title: Democrats would be favored to flip 3 Colorado congressional seats under new redistricting proposal
item.description: The proposal, brought by an organization called Coloradans for a Level Playing Field, would ask voters to temporarily override the independent redistricting process that they enshrined in the constitution less than a decade ago
